mutations.label: a zone carries a field the server never answers (an invented format)
the same invention, caught by the contract the observer validates every answer against
a zone omits a field the server always answers
count is the size of the page and not the total the filters matched
pagesize=-1 alone is refused instead of meaning everything
a list by an id the cloud never held is empty instead of a 431
starting a running machine succeeds, where the server accepts the command and fails the job

note: Every mutation here is a way the first version of the pack disagreed with the real CloudStack 4.23.0.0 server (internal/providers/cloudstack/testdata/simulator-4.23.0.0-recording.json holds what the server said), or a way the contract it is held to could be satisfied emptily. The first two carry the same invention to two different guards: the shape test compares field sets with the recording in both directions, and the contract test makes the observer validate every answer as it is produced; either alone leaves a hole the other covers. The fourth and fifth are paging, which the contract itself polices through PageBound, so a pack that mishandles it is wrong in a way the conformance run reports. The last is the failure that cost the most to find: the server answers HTTP 200 and a jobid, and the refusal travels in the job.
